resolvedFindings.evidence: A physical inhaler could pass while held still because inference-bound motion sampling was allowed near 3 fps and presence established the only ROI.
resolvedFindings.brokenRelationship: Inhaler presence was mistaken for completion of an up-and-down shake.
resolvedFindings.correction: Use a two-state detector. ONNX acquires and locks the inhaler once per attempt; the mixing state then accepts either a normal-speed position path with meaningful vertical range, travel and full reversals or the existing 30 fps motion/flow fast path. Static presence, horizontal movement, one-way vertical motion, low-rate high ratio, high ratio without coherent flow, and hand movement before inhaler acquisition are regression-tested as failures.

resolvedFindings.locator: stage 1 physical Brave camera and retry
resolvedFindings.evidence: The real demo tab measured only about 21 motion samples per second and repeatedly cleared its ROI while the user continued shaking. Awaiting the worker-based inhaler fallback also reduced hand reacquisition to a few frames per second. Progress reset after the model outage even though the physical action continued.
resolvedFindings.brokenRelationship: A sensing outage was treated as evidence that the learner stopped and erased valid progress.
resolvedFindings.correction: Throttle synchronous MediaPipe landmark inference to about 10 fps so the motion sampler remains near 30 fps; run initial ONNX acquisition without blocking hand inference; once acquired, stop repeated ONNX calls and retain the target lock until retry/reset. Freeze accumulated shake progress while action tracking is unavailable, display the retained duration, and reset only after a sustained visible non-shake or a bounded ten-second action-tracking outage.

resolvedFindings.evidence: The old stage called inhaler-away posture 'exhale detection' and required face plus ONNX detections to remain continuous for three seconds. Physical Brave testing repeatedly stalled despite the user performing the action, then passed only when posture happened to stay visible.
resolvedFindings.brokenRelationship: An unreliable posture proxy was presented as proof of pulmonary airflow, while detector flicker erased valid coaching progress.
resolvedFindings.correction: Use a two-stage visible-posture state machine: acquire face and inhaler, then lock one clearly-away observation from either the device or its holding hand. Stop Face, Hand and ONNX inference after the lock and run a truthful three-second guided exhale timer. The UI now says '吐氣引導完成' and does not claim lung emptying was sensed.
